Source: [plugins/aws/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/plugins/aws/doc.go).

Package aws is a regional AWS EC2 source plugin for instances, elastic network interfaces, and security groups, with optional VPC Flow Log ingestion from Amazon Data Firehose.

<span id="hdr-Source_and_collections"></span>

## Source and collections

The plugin polls EC2 Describe APIs with full pagination at startup, every poll interval, and immediately when an optional SQS subscriber reports a matching CloudTrail change. Polling, not the event stream, is authoritative: events only trigger a current-state read, so duplicates and reordering are harmless. Each object is content-digested so retries keep stable event IDs, and the plugin publishes the aws/ec2/\<region>/network-interfaces, instances, and security-groups collections.

<span id="hdr-Identity"></span>

## Identity

Resources use the aws.amazon.com/v1 Resource scheme. The authority is each resource's 12-digit owner account, not the caller account, so shared-VPC resources owned by another account keep their owner's identity. Immutable keys are \<partition>/ec2/\<region>/\<type>/\<id>. The source ID aws/\<partition>/\<caller-account>/\<region> identifies the observer only. [Plugin.ResolveIdentityReference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/plugins/aws#Plugin.ResolveIdentityReference) turns a Kubernetes Node's aws:// provider ID into an instance claim so Kubernetes can assert Node backed-by instance.

<span id="hdr-Graph_output_and_failure_behavior"></span>

## Graph output and failure behavior

The "inventory" contribution asserts instances, network interfaces, and security groups, network interface governed-by security group, and network interface exposes network destination for its current addresses, with an aws-security-group-rules facet carrying typed security semantics. An initial API failure prevents readiness. After a coherent publication, a failed poll republishes the last coherent input once with degraded health; recovery restores healthy status.

<span id="hdr-Telemetry"></span>

## Telemetry

[Plugin.FirehoseHandler](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/plugins/aws#Plugin.FirehoseHandler) authenticates Firehose HTTP endpoint deliveries for one stream and access key and decodes VPC Flow Log records with [NormalizeVPCFlowLog](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/plugins/aws#NormalizeVPCFlowLog). It acknowledges a delivery only after every event is accepted into the shared pipeline's bounded queue. A full queue blocks the delivery as backpressure, and a delivery abandoned while blocked returns 503 so Firehose retries. Raw events reach the sink before any graph rollup.

See docs/plugins/aws.md.
